paraphrase: Anything that unlocks features or content inside the app must be sold through in-app purchase, never through the app's own licence keys, QR codes, crypto or wallets. Purchased credits may not expire; restorable purchases need a restore mechanism; loot-box odds must be shown before purchase; digital gift cards and vouchers redeemable for digital goods must use IAP. A non-subscription app may offer a time-based free trial only as a Price Tier 0 non-consumable named "XX-day Trial", and before it starts must state its length, what stops working afterwards, and any later charges.
